scripts.ios:tests: cd apps/ios && xcodebuild test -project TuneAV.xcodeproj -scheme TuneAV -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16,OS=18.5' -only-testing:TuneAVTests CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
